species: To unravel the architecture of the yeast SPOTS complex, we generated a S. cerevisiae strain co-expressing Lcb1, Lcb2, Tsc3, Orm1, and Sac1 (Sup. Fig. 1a) under the control of the inducible GAL1 promoter.
To test if the SPOTS complex also exists in other organisms, we analyzed GFP-Sac1 pulldowns from D. discoideum (Fig. 4g) using mass spectrometry-based proteomics.
